name: Omarchy Lacquer
author: deunnis
description: One app for how your Omarchy desktop looks: themes, wallpapers, theme shuffle and aether generation; one motion feel for the whole desktop; fonts, GTK, icons, cursor and nightlight; window shape, border gradients built from your theme, animations and curves; sizes and displays; shell style, bar and menu look; lock, boot and the unlock screen; per-app window rules and launcher entries; terminals, btop, prompt and every plugin's settings. Live, through the tools that already own each setting.
